description: Practice problems from one lesson of a course on the family's account: the same practice set the lesson page shows after its reading, with each problem's skill, format and level. Name the lesson by its number (e.g. "1.2"), its practice set (e.g. "1A") or words from its title; leave it out to list the lessons that have practice problems. New problems come without answers; give their ids with include_solutions true for each answer and worked solution. Knowledge-check questions and graded test questions are never included.

count.description: How many new problems to return (default 3)

courseId.description: EduAvenues course id from list_my_courses (for example "tj-prep")

exclude.description: Ids already shown, so new problems are picked

ids.description: Ids of problems already shown, e.g. "1A-03", to return them again

include_solutions.description: With ids: include each answer and its worked solution

lesson.description: Lesson number like "1.2", practice set like "1A", or words from the lesson title

skill.description: Optional words from a skill, to pick problems on it

name: practice_problems
title: Practice problems from a lesson
